data_fields.name: highlightDotGrow
data_fields.donor_constant: 1 px to the left when highlighted

best_idea: A zone minimap rebuilt in a fixed slice of rows per update, with the viewport frame as corner brackets and a click that jumps the view, and entity dots that flash only while the matching list panel is open.
decision_why: Keep the slice budget, the corner-bracket frame, the click-to-jump and the list-linked highlight; drop the isometric transform, which does not fit Frankendom's 3D zones, and use a top-down projection of the ground plane. The fixed 16-row budget is not tied to map size, so rowsPerUpdate becomes a parameter set from zone size as data.
acceptance: A player clicks the minimap and the camera focus moves to that point on the next frame; a 128-tile zone's raster is fully refreshed within 8 updates; guest-equivalent dots flash only while the matching list panel is open.
